[Intro]
[Dm]
[C]
[Dm]
While In the

[Verse 1]
[Dm]merry month of may
from me home I started
Left the girls of Tuam
[C]nearly broken hearted Sa-
luted father [Dm]dear,
kissed my darling mother
Drank a pint of beer, my
[C]grief and tears to smother Then
off to reap the [Dm]corn,
leave where I was born
Cut a stout black thorn to
[C]banish ghosts and goblins;
Bought a pair of [Dm]brogues for
rattling o'er the bogs And
fright'ning all the dogs
[C]on the rocky road to Dublin

[Chorus]
[C]One, two, three four, [Dm]five
Hunt the Hare and turn her
down the rocky road
[C]All the way to Dublin,
Whack follol de [Dm]rah! In

[Verse 2]
[Dm]Mullingar that night I
rested limbs so weary
Started by daylight next
[C]morning blithe and early
Took a drop of the [Dm]pure to
keep me heart from sinking;
Thats a Paddy's cure whe-
[C]never he's on drinking They
hear the lassies [Dm]smile,
laughing all the while
At me curious style, 'twould
[C]set your heart a bubblin'
Asked me was I [Dm]hired,
wages I required 'till
I was almost tired
[C]of the rocky road to Dublin

[Chorus]
[C]One, two, three four, [Dm]five
Hunt the Hare and turn her
down the rocky road
[C]All the way to Dublin,
Whack follol de [Dm]rah! In

[Verse 3]
[Dm]Dublin next arrived, I
thought it's such a pity To
be soon deprived a
[C]view of that fine city
Then I took a [Dm]stroll,
all among the quality;
Me bundle it was stole, all
[C]in a neat locality
Something crossed me [Dm]mind,
when I looked behind No
bundle could I find u-
[C]pon me stick a wobblin' En-
quiring for the [Dm]rogue,
said me Connaught brogue
Wasn't much in vogue
[C]on the rocky road to Dublin

[Chorus]
[C]One, two, three four, [Dm]five
Hunt the Hare and turn her
down the rocky road
[C]All the way to Dublin,
Whack follol de [Dm]rah! From

[Verse 4]
[Dm]there I got away, me
spirits never falling
Landed on the quay, just
[C]as the ship was sailing The
Captain at me [Dm]roared,
said that no room had he;
When I jumped aboard, a
[C]cabin found for Paddy
Down among the [Dm]pigs,
played some hearty rigs
Danced some hearty jigs, the
[C]water round me bubbling;
When off [Dm]Holyhead I
wished meself was dead Or
better far instead
[C]on the rocky road to Dublin

[Chorus]
[C]One, two, three four, [Dm]five
Hunt the Hare and turn her
down the rocky road
[C]All the way to Dublin,
Whack follol de [Dm]rah! The

[Verse 5]
[Dm]boys of Liverpool,
when we safely landed
Called meself a fool, I
[C]could no longer stand it
Blood began to [Dm]boil,
temper I was losing;
Poor old Erin's Isle
[C]they began abusing "Hur-
rah me soul" says [Dm]I, me Shil-
lelagh I’ll apply
Galway boys were nigh and
[C]saw I was a hobble in
With a load [Dm]"hurray!"
joined in the affray
We quickly cleared the way
[C]for the rocky road to Dublin

[Chorus]
[C]One, two, three four, [Dm]five
Hunt the Hare and turn her
down the rocky road
[C]All the way to Dublin,
Whack follol de [Dm]rah!
